# 💳 Save Email to Doc (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that finds a Gmail message, fetches its content, creates a Google Doc and writes the email body into it for archival or reference. Complementary to the sibling recipe save-email-attachments (lot 31): that one saves the message's attachments to Drive; this one saves the message body to a Doc — run both for a complete archive. Also the reverse of the sibling draft-email-from-doc (Doc → email). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-gmail and gws-docs utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; only the body is saved — metadata like headers and threading context are written as plain text, not preserved as email structure. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
